Markets.title: US stocks: S&P 500, Nasdaq end lower as crude prices jump, chip stocks weigh
Markets.summary: US stock indexes, including the S&P 500 and Nasdaq, fell on Thursday due to surging crude oil prices caused by Middle East tensions. Additionally, chip stocks declined after OpenAI disclosed a revenue target cut.

Markets.title: Tech stocks drag Nasdaq lower on report of OpenAI revenue fall, high yields
Markets.summary: US equity indexes fell, led by megacap technology stocks, as OpenAI revenue concerns and rising 10-year Treasury yields pressured the market. Additional pressure came from higher oil prices, energy supply fears, and Federal Reserve signals of potential interest rate increases.

Markets.title: US 30-year fixed-rate mortgage rate hits 7.40%, likely to further erode housing demand
Markets.summary: The U.S. 30-year fixed-rate mortgage has surged to 7.40% due to rising inflation and Treasury yields. This increase is worsening affordability challenges and causing homeowners to withhold their properties from the market.

Markets.title: US President Donald Trump buys $1 million-plus stakes in Meta, Microsoft, McDonald’s; adds SpaceX debt
Markets.summary: In August, Donald Trump invested over $1 million in major companies, including Meta, Microsoft, McDonald's, and SpaceX debt. These financial activities also included trading shares of AI sector leaders like Nvidia and Advanced Micro Devices.

Markets.title: Infosys, Wipro ADRs fall nearly 3% after TCS earnings, US crackdown on H-1B-linked green card programme
Markets.summary: Infosys and Wipro ADRs dropped nearly 3% in US trading following TCS's quarterly results and new US immigration restrictions. Investors reacted to growing concerns over technology spending, AI disruption, and tighter employment-based immigration policies impacting Indian IT stocks.

Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Friday
Markets.summary: Indian markets plunged on Thursday due to RBI policy tightening, foreign institutional investor selling, rising bond yields, and rupee weakness. The Nifty hit a 52-week low of 22,179, and the Sensex fell 1,045 points, wiping out over Rs 10 lakh crore in investor wealth.

Geo-Political.title: Suspect linked to Monaco bomb attack on millionaire breaks silence to BBC
Geo-Political.summary: Vitalii Zhykovych has broken his silence to the BBC regarding the attempted assassination of Ukrainian-born businessman Vadym Yermolayev. Zhykovych provided his own account of the bomb attack that targeted the millionaire in Monaco.

Geo-Political.title: Fort Hood attacker's execution by firing squad will be livestreamed, Pentagon says
Geo-Political.summary: US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth announced on Thursday that the execution of the Fort Hood attacker by firing squad will be livestreamed. The Pentagon confirmed that the public will be able to watch the event.

Geo-Political.title: Russian strike on buses kills at least 30, say officials, as deadly attacks on Ukraine surge
Geo-Political.summary: A Russian strike on two crowded buses in Kramatorsk killed at least 30 people. Ukrainian officials accused Russia of intentionally targeting civilians as deadly attacks across the country surge.

Geo-Political.title: Christa Pike now walking after failed US execution, lawyer tells BBC
Geo-Political.summary: Christa Pike, the murderer of Colleen Slemmer, survived two lethal injection attempts at a United States execution. Her lawyer told the BBC that she is now able to walk around her hospital room.

Geo-Political.title: Adidas sues Australian label White Fox over four stripes design
Geo-Political.summary: German sportswear brand Adidas is suing Sydney-based label White Fox for allegedly copying its trademarked stripes design. Adidas is demanding financial damages and an immediate halt to the sale of the disputed clothing items.

Geo-Political.title: Protesters blame 'vulture funds' for Spain's housing crisis
Geo-Political.summary: Hundreds of protesters pitched tents in central Madrid to blame "vulture funds" for Spain's escalating housing crisis. In response to the growing political pressure, the Spanish prime minister called a snap election.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: A creator discovered their WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result by ChatGPT without paying for ads. This experiment highlights a shift in organic traffic strategies from traditional SEO to AI optimization (AIO).

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools That Will Transform Your Content Creation in 2025
AI & Tech.summary: The digital landscape has evolved to make AI tools essential for content creators in 2025. This guide highlights the top 10 AI tools designed to revolutionize content creation and simplify creators' workflows.

AI & Tech.title: LimeWire AI Studio Review 2023: Details, Pricing & Features
AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has transformed from a file-sharing service into a generative AI platform for content creation. The tool allows users to generate, share, and monetize their artificial intelligence creations.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools in 2023 That Will Make Your Life Easier
AI & Tech.summary: This article explores ten advanced artificial intelligence tools designed to automate repetitive tasks and boost workplace productivity across various industries. These widely used market solutions improve workflows and drive efficiency for a variety of specific applications.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Content Generator & Writer Tools in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: The article introduces AI content generators as effective tools for creating engaging and relevant material for audiences. It notes that with numerous options currently available on the market, choosing the right tool can be challenging.

AI & Tech.title: Beginner Guide to CJ Affiliate (Commission Junction) in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: This beginner's guide to CJ Affiliate explains how the network works and how to earn money on the platform. It also highlights top CJ affiliate programs, alternatives, and answers frequently asked questions.

Data & Insights.title: GST Council Meeting Oct 2026: List of decisions taken - Arrest, prosecution, general penalty and more
Data & Insights.summary: The GST Council's October 2026 meeting removed arrest powers for GST officers and raised the prosecution threshold to ₹5 crore. Additional decisions include reducing general penalties, accelerating refunds, and simplifying the registration process.

Data & Insights.title: Homecooked food gets expensive, vegetarians to pay more than non-vegetarians amid onion, rice, LPG price hike: Crisil
Data & Insights.summary: In September 2026, the cost of a home-cooked vegetarian thali rose to ₹30.8 from ₹28.1 the previous year. Concurrently, the price of a non-vegetarian thali increased to ₹59.5 from ₹56, driven by higher onion, rice, and LPG prices.

Data & Insights.title: India signs pact to address global excess capacity: What is it? Who are the 15 signatories? Check joint statement
Data & Insights.summary: India and 14 other global economies signed an agreement to combat market-distorting policies that cause excess manufacturing capacity. The signatories will share information and develop coordinated responses to address the issue.

Data & Insights.title: India eyes $1 trillion exports despite weak global trade outlook: Piyush Goyal
Data & Insights.summary: India is aiming for a $1 trillion export target despite a weak global trade outlook projecting only 2.5% to 3% growth. Achieving this goal will require the country to sustain an export growth rate of nearly 16%.

Data & Insights.title: GST Council meet: Tax officers' arrest power scrapped; easier e-comm norms for small sellers — Check key highlights
Data & Insights.summary: The GST Council raised the prosecution threshold to ₹5 crore and removed tax officers' arrest powers in certain cases. It also simplified compliance for small e-commerce sellers and shortened timelines for acknowledging refund applications.

Data & Insights.title: Retail inflation likely hit 23-month high of 5.6% in September: Mint poll
Data & Insights.summary: A Mint poll shows retail inflation in September likely reached a 23-month high of 5.6%. This expected rate exceeds the Reserve Bank of India's 4% target for the fourth consecutive month.

India.title: INDIA Bloc Protest Highlights: INDIA Bloc Protesters Meet At Delhi Cafe To Discuss Forward Strategy
India.summary: Several opposition leaders were detained on Wednesday after staging a sit-in and demanding the election chief's resignation. Earlier, members of the INDIA bloc met at a Delhi cafe to discuss their forward strategy.

India.title: Bhagwant Mann Aide Goes To Court, Says Raid Illegal, Agency Had No Approval
India.summary: Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann's OSD, Rajbir Singh Ghuman, has filed a petition in the Punjab and Haryana High Court. He is challenging a CBI raid at his Sangrur residence, claiming the search was illegal and conducted without proper approval.

India.title: Rat Seen Swimming In Vessel Full Of Gulab Jamun In Maharashtra
India.summary: Authorities in Maharashtra investigated a viral video showing a rat swimming inside a large vessel filled with gulab jamun and sugar syrup. The footage sparked widespread concern regarding food safety and hygiene standards at the unidentified local establishment.

India.title: Congress Alleges Police Manhandled Ex-Assam Chief During Guwahati Protest
India.summary: The Congress party alleges that police manhandled a former Assam chief minister during a protest in Guwahati. The demonstration was held to condemn police action against opposition members of parliament in Delhi.

India.title: Court Ruling Today On AIADMK Plea Against Nod To 6 Rebel MLAs' Resignations
India.summary: A court will rule today on an AIADMK petition challenging the approval of resignations submitted by six rebel MLAs. These legislators previously faced disqualification proceedings for defying the party whip by voting for the TVK government during a trust vote.

India.title: 5 Injured In Fire Caused By Gas Leak In Hostel On IIT Bombay Campus
India.summary: Five people, including two children, were injured in a fire at an IIT Bombay campus hostel. The fire was caused by a gas leak.

General.title: ADHD and autism at risk of over-diagnosis, says government review
General.summary: A government review warns that younger people face a growing risk of ADHD and autism over-diagnosis or mis-diagnosis. The findings suggest society is shifting from an era of under-diagnosis to one of over-identifying these conditions.

General.title: Polanski failed to show leadership over Zionism motion, ex-Green leader says
General.summary: Former Green Party leader Caroline Lucas stated that Zack Polanski failed to show leadership by abstaining from a vote. The vote concerned a motion that declared Zionism to be a form of racism.

General.title: Warrants used to search Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor's homes were unlawful, court says
General.summary: A court ruled that the police search warrants used on Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor's homes were unlawful. The criminal investigation against him continues, and police are still holding the seized material.

General.title: Suspect linked to Monaco bomb attack on millionaire breaks silence to BBC
General.summary: Vitalii Zhykovych has spoken to the BBC regarding his alleged involvement in a bomb attack against Ukrainian-born millionaire Vadym Yermolayev in Monaco. Zhykovych provided his own account of the attempted assassination to the broadcaster.

General.title: Fort Hood attacker's execution by firing squad will be livestreamed, Pentagon says
General.summary: US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth announced on Thursday that the execution of the Fort Hood attacker by firing squad will be livestreamed. The Pentagon confirmed that the event will be made available for the public to watch.

General.title: Emotions run high at the round table as Celebrity Traitors banish two players
General.summary: Emotions ran high at the first round table of the new series of Celebrity Traitors. Viewers watched to see if Richard E Grant could save himself as two players were banished.
